dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetric linear narrowing from the mid-dorsal region toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Lateral margins are predominantly smooth and symmetric, exhibiting a consistent convex profile without localized bulges or indentations.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Median pixel intensity is consistent with a uniform light grey to off-white skin tone across the visible dorsal area.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Presence of multiple faint, light-colored longitudinal linear streaks along the mid-to-posterior central dorsal axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Superficial longitudinal marks, consistent with rake marks or healed scratches, are visible as light-toned linear streaks on the dorsal surface.
